cohort: The study included 9 patients diagnosed with peripartum cardiomyopathy (PPCM) out of 12,880 deliveries at a tertiary care center in Mumbai, India over a 2-year period.
finding: Peripartum cardiomyopathy (PPCM) was found in 0.07% of deliveries, was more common in young primigravidas (first pregnancy), and was strongly associated with preeclampsia.
